messages.author: e5c9e77ddb11312c
messages.subject: list of order of options?
parts:
Is there a list somewhere to check where to put an option?  I'm working on this messy figure and have it nearly right but wanted to split the legend into 2 columns.  After spending an hour or so scouring the interwebs for ways to do this, I've finally figured out that guides(col=guide_legend(ncol=2)) doesn't seem to do anything with geom_bar(). Adding guide=guide_legend(ncol=2) to the scale_fill_manual does split the legend. Why does a legend in geom_bar behave differently than one for a scatter plot?


why would this work:

p <- ggplot()+
  geom_hline(yintercept=0, colour="grey")+
  geom_bar(data= tuk.pos[order(tuk.pos$phyla),], aes(x=factor(treatment,levels=c("0-1", "0-2", "1-2", "0-3", "1-3", "2-3")), y=diff, fill=phyla), stat="identity")+
  geom_bar(data= tuk.neg[order(tuk.neg$phyla),], aes(x=factor(treatment,levels=c("0-1", "0-2", "1-2", "0-3", "1-3", "2-3")), y=diff, fill=phyla), stat="identity")+
  facet_grid(domain~horizon, scales="free_y")+
  scale_fill_manual(values=bac.fung.tuk.color, guide=guide_legend(ncol=2))



but this doesn't: 

p <- ggplot()+
  geom_hline(yintercept=0, colour="grey")+
  geom_bar(data= tuk.pos[order(tuk.pos$phyla),], aes(x=factor(treatment,levels=c("0-1", "0-2", "1-2", "0-3", "1-3", "2-3")), y=diff, fill=phyla), stat="identity")+
  geom_bar(data= tuk.neg[order(tuk.neg$phyla),], aes(x=factor(treatment,levels=c("0-1", "0-2", "1-2", "0-3", "1-3", "2-3")), y=diff, fill=phyla), stat="identity")+
  facet_grid(domain~horizon, scales="free_y")+
  scale_fill_manual(values=bac.fung.tuk.color)+
  guides(col=guide_legend(ncol=2)

messages.author: e5c9e77ddb11312c
messages.subject: Re: list of order of options?
parts:
Or for an example using mtcars


this doesn't change the legend:
ggplot()+
  guides(col=guide_legend(ncol=2))+
  geom_bar(data=mtcars, aes(x=factor(cyl), y=wt, fill=factor(gear)), stat="identity")

This does, but it's not obvious why I can only ask the legend to be 2 columns if I specify the colors.
ggplot()+
  geom_bar(data=mtcars, aes(x=factor(cyl), y=wt, fill=factor(gear)), stat="identity")+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette=1,guide=guide_legend(ncol=2))

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: list of order of options?
parts:
On Mon, Oct 27, 2014 at 1:31 PM, Kendra Maas <kendra...@gmail.com> wrote:
> yes, I did figure it out. But I'm trying to understand the logic behind
> this so I don't spend hours trying to figure out a work around in the
> future.

The logic is simply that fill and color are not the same thing.

guides(col=guide_legend(ncol=2))+

says "make the color guide have two columns". But the plot

doesn't have a color guide (because nothing is mapped to color). It
has a fill guide, because fill is mapped to factor(gear). So you are
presumably looking for

guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol=2))


The difference between color and fill is that (for two dimensional
geoms) fill is the inside color and color is the outside color.

Hope this helps,
Ista
